_doc: Readiness gates per market. Versioned: every change is a commit (who, when, why). A store may switch a gate OFF locally in an emergency (wp ym market off <gate>); it can never switch one ON beyond this file. Gates are enforced on staging and production. See docs/MARKETS.md.

_gates.prepared: Store configured: currency, phones, regions and fees, copy and policy pages, tracking config. Its homepage existing is not enough.
_gates.catalog: At least one offer passes the catalog gate and Rashid approved the assortment. Off = store not indexable, no sitemap, nothing purchasable.
_gates.checkout: Orders accepted. Needs a verified supplier link and a test order in THIS country. Off = buy buttons hidden, checkout refuses orders, country hidden from the switcher and the root chooser.
_gates.ads: Paid advertising allowed. Needs live measurement checks for this country. Off = ad spend is reported as 0; any recorded spend is flagged.
